summary: Mega Fortune Company Limited, a Cayman-incorporated IoT solutions provider operating in Hong Kong, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's interim report) announcing unaudited first-half fiscal 2026 results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. Revenue collapsed 90.3% to US$522,171 from US$5,371,613, with IoT integration services down 89.2%, BPO down 97.4%, and support/maintenance down 86.5%. The company swung to a net loss of US$3,411,607 from income of US$912,439, driven by revenue decline plus sharply higher selling and marketing and G&A expenses. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine earnings filing.
